title: Art. 4.6 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 4 - Entry and Departure of Cargo and Other Articles, A. General, 4.6
content: Contracting States shall not normally require the physical examination of cargo to be imported or exported and shall use risk management to determine which goods shall be examined and the extent of that examination.
